notes.subject: Kristy call notes — handwritten outreach history
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes say she spoke with Cresta at the Eureka/Lincoln Chamber on April 27, 2026. Cresta needed Adventure Zone information for several events and said she would forward it to the fair board. Phone 406-297-4636 is written. Preserve as a multi-event relationship lead rather than a single cold event.

followUps.label: 2027 Eureka event follow-up
followUps.reason: Cresta said the chamber had several events and would forward information to the fair board. Check which 2027 events are the best fit and who owns each decision.
